subject: [PATCH v3 0/2] memcg: reduce cacheline contention from lruvec stat

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch reduces cacheline contention between lruvec stat updates and LRU lists by rearranging the layout of struct mem_cgroup_per_node to pair read-mostly lines with cold lines, and modifying folio and kmem stat updates to avoid going through the lruvec. This change improves performance on systems that use spatial prefetching, such as Intel CPUs. The patch includes two changes: one that reorders the fields in struct mem_cgroup_per_node, and another that modifies the stat update functions to skip using the lruvec. The results show a significant improvement in pages per second for threads faulting in and freeing memory in a single memcg.
